reference_sql:
WITH weeks AS (
  -- one row per week, the weeks of 3 to 24 March 2025
  SELECT DISTINCT week_start
  FROM calendar
  WHERE week_start BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-03' AND DATE '2025-03-24'
), parents AS (
  -- one row per parent category
  SELECT DISTINCT parent_category
  FROM categories
), weekly AS (
  -- one row per parent category and week with sales
  SELECT parent_category, order_week AS week_start, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_week BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-03' AND DATE '2025-03-24'
  GROUP BY parent_category, order_week
)
SELECT p.parent_category, w.week_start, COALESCE(s.units, 0) AS units
FROM parents p
CROSS JOIN weeks w
LEFT JOIN weekly s ON s.parent_category = p.parent_category AND s.week_start = w.week_start

solver.query:
WITH weeks AS (
  SELECT CAST(d AS DATE) AS week_start FROM generate_series(DATE '2025-03-03', DATE '2025-03-24', INTERVAL 7 DAY) t(d)
), cats AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT parent_category FROM categories
), u AS (
  SELECT parent_category, order_week AS week_start, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_week BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-03' AND DATE '2025-03-24'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT c.parent_category, w.week_start, COALESCE(u.units, 0) AS units
FROM cats c CROSS JOIN weeks w
LEFT JOIN u ON u.parent_category = c.parent_category AND u.week_start = w.week_start
